historical.purpose: environment used for the initial build and first replay runs
historical.notes: uv-managed virtual environment; packages pinned at build time.

current.purpose: environment for the final historical runs reproduced in this repository
current.notes: uv-managed virtual environment; all historical runs in outputs/runs/ are reproducible under this snapshot.

reproducibility_policy: Result hashes depend only on data hash, config hash, seed, model/rule version, and result-file contents; environment versions are recorded for provenance but do not enter result hashes.
